Building scalable systems that power tomorrow’s SaaS solutions. I thrive at the intersection of complex problem-solving and innovation, driven by the challenge of creating resilient, high-performance backend infrastructure. My work is about turning abstract ideas into reliable, impactful systems that scale with confidence.  

At NebulaTech, I architect and maintain microservices-driven platforms using Go and Python, ensuring seamless integration across distributed systems. Leveraging AWS, I’ve optimized PostgreSQL performance to reduce query latency by 40%, while designing REST APIs that now underpin 80% of our platform’s integrations. Kubernetes and Docker streamline deployments, and Terraform ensures our infrastructure evolves with precision.  

Recently, I spearheaded a rewrite of our payment processing pipeline, cutting response times by 60% and improving system reliability. I also mentored two junior engineers, helping them own critical modules—proof that collaboration amplifies impact.  

I’m seeking opportunities to shape next-gen backend architectures, tackle large-scale challenges, and contribute to projects that redefine what’s possible in SaaS. Let’s build something that lasts.
